handling_notes: Keep sparse and fully connected cases separate; do not merge their measurements.
Neither file supplies the exact profiled source revision or raw profiler output.
Both report 64-bit VertexOffsets; the locally pinned DX100 source defines SGOffset as int32_t. Do not silently reconcile them.
Distance-threshold locality labels are not verified same-cacheline/page membership or cache-hit rates.
Footprints need explicit MB/MiB units and are not automatically tile-scoped working sets.
Hardware implications are hypotheses, not mandatory architecture constraints.
Dense-case CAS is described as active in the discovery phase and bypassed in the second phase; retain this distinction.
